service.head: Support by K Aqua technicians on your construction site.
service.text: Does your team need instruction on the machines directly at the installation site? We will coordinate one of our supervisors to accompany your project in the critical start-up phase.
service.done: Our service team is checking the availability of a supervisor.

maerkte_trinkwasser.head: Every lost percent of drinking water costs your network hard cash.
maerkte_trinkwasser.short: Loss calculation for your drinking water network
maerkte_trinkwasser.text: Briefly describe the network size and climate zone. We will calculate how much water and budget a K Aqua field saves compared to the existing system, including years of operation.
maerkte_trinkwasser.done: A network planner will contact you within one business day with an initial loss calculation.

maerkte_klima.head: Ensure high flow rates without the risk of corrosion.
maerkte_klima.text: Tell us the cooling capacity and flow temperature. We will dimension the cross-section so that cavitation and pressure losses in your HVAC system are minimized.
maerkte_klima.done: An HVAC expert will contact you regarding cross-section design.

maerkte_industrie.head: Chemical resistance for demanding pumped media.
maerkte_industrie.text: Do you process aggressive acids, alkalis, or ultrapure water? Send us the chemical composition, and our labouratory will confirm the resistance of our PP-R pipes in writing.
maerkte_industrie.done: Our labouratory will check the resistance and get back to you.

maerkte_schiffbau.head: Lightweight construction and vibration resistance for marine networks.
maerkte_schiffbau.text: Whether grey, black, or ballast water: Tell us the ship class. We will send you the corresponding classification certificates (DNV, Lloyd's) for our system.
maerkte_schiffbau.done: A marine expert will send you the relevant certificates.

maerkte_landwirtschaft.head: Robust irrigation networks for maximum yields.
maerkte_landwirtschaft.text: Tell us the number of hectares and the water requirement. We will design a frost-proof, long-lasting PP-R network that prevents blockages caused by algae growth through complete opacity.
maerkte_landwirtschaft.done: We will contact you shortly to discuss your irrigation network.

maerkte.head: Speak with an export specialist for your region.
maerkte.short: Logistics and approval for your country
maerkte.text: We export worldwide. Tell us the destination country, and we will inform you about local standards, local sales partners, and realistic ocean freight transit times from our plant.
maerkte.done: An export manager for your region will contact you.

loesungen_hochhaus.head: Pressure stabilization in extreme risers.
loesungen_hochhaus.text: Hydromechanics in high-rise building tolerates no errors. Tell us the building height and number of floors, and we will help position pressure reducers and expansion bends.
loesungen_hochhaus.done: A high-rise hydraulics specialist will contact you for a discussion.

loesungen_krankenhaus.head: Sterility and legionella prevention in clinical operations.
loesungen_krankenhaus.text: The protection of immunocompromised patients is the top priority. We advise you on ring mains, dead space avoidance, and thermal disinfection with our PP-R system.
loesungen_krankenhaus.done: An expert in drinking water hygiene will contact you immediately.

loesungen_hotel.head: Acoustic decoupling for your guests' undisturbed sleep.
loesungen_hotel.text: Flow noises in adjacent rooms lead to complaints. Tell us the wall structures, and we will recommend sound-insulating fastenings and flow optimizations.
loesungen_hotel.done: We will contact you regarding the optimization of sound insulation in your facility.

loesungen.head: Individual system solutions for complex construction projects.
loesungen.short: Technical consulting for your special project
loesungen.text: Standard solutions are not enough for your project? Outline the challenge to us, and our design department will draft custom manifolds and special components.
loesungen.done: Our design department will review your request and get back to you.

co2_rechner.head: Let us validate the footprint of your project.
co2_rechner.text: The calculator provides initial reference values. Send us the exact bill of materials, and we will create a detailed certificate of the CO2 savings compared to metal pipes for your sustainability audit.
co2_rechner.done: A sustainability officer will contact you to create the certificate.

trust_centre.head: Do you need a specific certificate for building acceptance?
trust_centre.text: If the inspector on the construction site asks for a specific proof (DVGW, SKZ, KIWA), tell us the standard. We will send you the current document directly as a PDF.
trust_centre.done: We will look for the appropriate certificate and send it to you.

projektanfrage.head: Give us the key data, and we will provide an initial budget.
projektanfrage.text: In the next step, upload your plans or give us the rough square meters and type of use over the phone in advance. We will give you an initial price range.
projektanfrage.done: The project team will contact you to discuss the budget.

kontakt.head: Your shortest path to the K Aqua headquarters.
kontakt.short: We will call you on the construction site
kontakt.text: No holding lines. Enter your number and specify the rough topic. The appropriate specialist consultant from sales or engineering will contact you immediately.
kontakt.done: Your inquiry has been received. The appropriate consultant will get back to you right away.

news.head: Questions about a press release or product innovation?
news.text: For high-resolution images, interviews with management, or technical background information on our innovations, simply leave your contact details.
news.done: Our press department will contact you shortly.

karriere.head: Ask an informal question about our vacancies.
karriere.short: Direct line to the HR department
karriere.text: Are you unsure whether your profile fits, or would you like to clarify details about everyday work before applying? Our HR team answers your questions easily over the phone.
karriere.done: The HR department will contact you for a brief introduction.

partnerschaft.head: Expand your product range with premium German pipe.
partnerschaft.text: Are you a wholesaler looking for a reliable PP-R supplier? Tell us your region and target group, and we will discuss exclusivity models and dealer conditions.
partnerschaft.done: Our sales manager for partnerships will contact you.

impressum.head: Questions about our company details?
impressum.text: Leave your number here if you have legal or formal questions about our company.
impressum.done: We will get back to you to clarify your question.

datenschutz.head: Speak with our data protection officer.
datenschutz.text: We take your privacy seriously. If you would like information, deletion, or details about the processing of your data, please leave your contact details.
datenschutz.done: The data protection officer will contact you immediately.

fallback.head: Speak directly with our engineers.
fallback.text: Phone number, email, one click on your topic. That's all it takes, we'll clarify the rest in conversation.
fallback.done: A specialist consultant will contact you within one business day.

hero.lead: From Waldsolms to the world: K-Aqua PP-R and PP-RCT systems have been running for decades in high-rises, hospitals, industrial plants and ships, under conditions that do not allow a second try. Engineering that proves itself, in every project.

manifesto.title: Doctrine of Precision
manifesto.p1: In an industry where material fatigue and corrosion are considered inevitable, our manufacturing sets a different standard. We don't consider each pipe a component, but rather the result of applied materials science. Every batch of PP-R copolymer, every weld seam, and every wall thickness undergoes a testing process that prefers to accept rejects rather than exceeding tolerances. This is the fundamental law of the K-Aqua Reference Class.
manifesto.p2: Our systems run in environments where a single leak point endangers the operation of an entire hospital or high-rise. We use long-term internal pressure tests according to ISO 9080 not as a labouratory formality, but as a hard requirement for every released dimension: extrapolation to 50 years of operation at a specified temperature and pressure rating, documented, traceable, and traceable by batch.
manifesto.p3: We deliberately refrain from opaque material mixtures. Our formulation is documented throughout the entire manufacturing chain, from the polymer batch to the finished pipe length. We calibrate extrusion temperatures precisely to the degree, optimise the fiber composite middle layer against linear expansion, and log every electrofusion weld with exact process parameters. The result is systems that effortlessly remain within the standard range at 70°C continuous operation and PN20.
manifesto.p4: For us, quality assurance is not a downstream testing step, but part of every production stage. By consistently applying DVGW, SKZ, and KIWA certification to all relevant dimensions, we proactively remove any point of attack for failure risks. A system manufactured according to DIN 8077/8078 and triply certified can never prove to be a weak point.

metrics.lead: Our systems are not advertised, they are tested. These are the core metrics of our technological doctrine.

pressure.title: Long-Term Pressure Test according to ISO 9080
pressure.desc: Every released dimension undergoes internal pressure tests at several temperature levels over thousands of operating hours, extrapolated onto a regression line for a 50-year lifespan.
pressure.placeholder: Regression curve of long-term internal pressure test

isolation.title: Seamless Batch Traceability
isolation.desc: Every pipe length carries a batch number that can be traced back to the polymer delivery, for seamless documentation during building acceptance and warranty.

tolerance.title: Wall Thickness Tolerance in the Micrometer Range
tolerance.desc: Continuous ultrasonic wall thickness measurement during extrusion keeps every dimension exactly within the DIN 8077/8078 tolerance fields.

network.title: Global Sales and Service Network
network.desc: From Waldsolms, we supply projects in over 35 countries and ensure technical consulting, training, and spare parts supply, even after building acceptance.

welding.title: Uncompromising Weld Seam Integrity
welding.desc: Every heating element socket weld follows a documented time-temperature-pressure profile. Random tensile tests and micrographs confirm the molecular fusion of pipe and fitting, without seals, without weak points.
welding.placeholder: Micrograph of a K-Aqua socket weld joint

cta.lead: Are you planning a high-rise, an industrial plant, or a hospital project? Our engineers are waiting for your specifications, with solid test data instead of marketing promises.

seoExpansion.p1: As a global leader in the manufacturing of PP-R and PPRCT piping systems, K-Aqua provides robust, resilient, and highly efficient fluid management solutions for drinking water, heating, and cooling networks. Our product portfolio spans from standard PP-R pipes SDR 11 to specialized glass-fiber reinforced multi-layer pipes (PP-RCT) which offer exceptional resistance against extreme temperatures and high-pressure loads. From residential plumbing networks to massive industrial fluid distribution grids, our pipes ensure maximum operational safety. Extruded with state-of-the-art German machinery, every pipe is engineered to deliver zero-leakage performance over a lifecycle exceeding 50 years. With a focus on hygiene, our drinking water pipes are certified by rigorous international testing bodies to prevent the growth of legionella and strictly preserve the purity and taste of potable water across hospitals, hotels, and public infrastructure.
seoExpansion.p2: Beyond the essential piping architecture, K-Aqua provides an exhaustively comprehensive range of injection-molded fittings, transition joints, and heavy-duty valves. Our PP-R and PP-RCT fittings include elbows, tees, reducers, and electrofusion sockets designed to seamlessly fuse with the pipe infrastructure, creating a monolithic, chemically bonded network that is virtually indestructible. We integrate precision-machined brass and DZR (Dezincification Resistant) metal threads for perfect transitional compatibility with existing metal plumbing components. To facilitate frictionless installation, we offer professional-grade polyfusion welding tools, from manual socket welders to massive hydraulic butt-welding machines. This complete ecosystem ensures that contractors and engineers can rely on a single, unified system architecture for any complex installation requirement.
seoExpansion.t3: Sustainability, Life Cycle Assessment & CO2 Reduction
seoExpansion.p3: Sustainability is deeply embedded within the molecular engineering of our PP-R and PPRCT systems. By providing a remarkably low internal surface roughness of 0.007 mm, our pipes drastically reduce the hydraulic friction and pressure loss across the network. According to the Darcy-Weisbach flow dynamic models, this minimal resistance translates directly into massively reduced energy consumption for circulation pumps. Over a 50-year operational lifecycle, this efficiency yields unparalleled CO2 emissions savings and substantially lowers the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) for building operators. Furthermore, polypropylene is 100% recyclable. Through our validated Type III Environmental Product Declarations (EPD) complying with EN 15804, we provide architects and green-building planners with transparent, quantifiable data for LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB certifications.
seoExpansion.p4: Manufactured entirely in Germany under strict ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 50001 quality and environmental management protocols, K-Aqua exports premium piping solutions to over 50 countries worldwide. Our logistics network guarantees the rapid, secure delivery of complete systems to mega-projects in the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and across Europe. Our relentless commitment to quality is validated by major international certification bodies including DVGW, SKZ, WRAS, and KIWA. We empower consulting engineers, BIM modelers, and large-scale contractors with detailed CAD/BIM libraries, intelligent calculation software, and comprehensive technical support to ensure flawless project execution. K-Aqua represents the ultimate synthesis of advanced polymer science, sustainable engineering, and uncompromising reliability in fluid management.
